title: Episode 87 — The Randhawas Join the Khalsa

blocks.text: Episode 87 begins by locating the Randhawa villages near Chamunda and Kairon Nangal, where A few among these Randhawas joined the Khalsa Panth and accepted the sharpened discipline that came with initiation.
Armed and newly resolute, they are remembered as people who refused quiet submission and And started waylaying (the Mughals) on the Lahore-Delhi highway, turning local roads into contested ground.
That boldness drew an immediate response, because The Mughals launched an attack to eliminate them once the Randhawas became an open Khalsa challenge rather than a hidden sympathy.
